title: The cryptofication of JD Vance
content:
Memes mocking Vice President J. D. Vance have gone viral online, giving him an endless string of bizarre digital makeovers as a chubby-cheeked, childish kid with a lollipop, spinning propeller hats, and a Willy Wonka-inspired blueberry transformation.
